shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. Levels and per-level size are bought from a 146,000-cell budget; colder with altitude, richer ore and more cave with depth. Coast, river and lake tiles supported; Dubs Mint Minimap and Map Preview both patched. Rendering, interaction and generation all verified in play.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED**. ~66 files / ~17,300 LOC.

## Pitch
Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

> **QOL pass VERIFIED (#172). §6b-LAKE CLOSED as vanilla appearance (#173/#174).**
> **ALTITUDE PASS (snow line + cross-level weather + wind) WRITTEN, BUILD GREEN, UNTESTED — §7 and §16.**

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`; bands along **+z** from the deepest basement; permanently-fogged gutter between bands; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)×64` — **64-alignment is load-bearing**. Per-level sizes 126 / 190 / 254.
**⚠ THE STACK IS 2-7× ANISOTROPIC.** Any vanilla system normalising by BOTH map dimensions is distorted, and on a square map that bug class cannot appear. First suspect for any "smeared/stretched" symptom (§6b-LAKE; §6c's `DrawTextureFitted` one layer up).

### The one insight
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum; `Reachability.CanReach` works **unpatched**. **But reachability ≠ a path** — 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

### Hard 1.6 constraints
Path grid is an IJobParallelFor over EVERY cell ⇒ **total stacked cells is the runtime metric** · no `PathFinder.FindPath` · `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE
| Shape | Example | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| **Anchor** — a point picked as a fraction of `Size.z` | river / lake centre (§6b); random/edge cell (§15a) | remap the point |
| **Field** — a gradient centred on the map centre | coastline (§6e) | re-centre the sample coordinate |
| **Noise space** — a slice ≠ a short map | Map Preview (§6d) | generate at full height, then crop |
| **Distance-to-extent** — a margin measured off `Size` | `CloseToEdge`, no-build edge (§15b/§15d) | re-base onto the cell's own band rect |
| **Aspect ratio** — normalised by BOTH dims | water surface (§6b-LAKE) | *none — cosmetic, accepted* |
| **⚠ MAP-WIDE SCALAR** — a per-tick value computed once for the whole map | snow melt (§7), weather, wind | **rewrite it per cell at the consumer** |
**Classify a new bug into one of these six — but PROVE it.** The map-wide-scalar shape is the newest and the most dangerous, because the value is *correct*, just not per-band, so nothing looks wrong in the code. Still unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — cell budget = **146,000**
`4 × 190 = 145,920` sets the figure; `2 × 254 = 130,048`, `7 × 126 = 112,896`; `5 × 190` and `7 × 190` refused.
`ABMapSizeLimit` owns it: `UpperLevels`/`LowerLevels` (0-3), `BandCount`, `SurfaceBand = lower`, `Fits`, `MaxSize`, `MaxLevelsFor`, `StackedCells`.
**Per-level size is SQUARE (`Size.x == bandHeight`)** — why `GenStep_Scatterer.CountFromPer10kCells` (squaring `Size.x`, not `map.Area`) already yields a per-BAND count. Only `GenStep_AnimaTrees` and `GenStep_TerrainPatches` read `map.Area`.
**⚠ THE LEVEL CHOOSER IS ALSO THE LAB.** `0 above / 0 below` = an ORDINARY single-level map, the vanilla control. Band count sets `Size.z`, so it is a **calibrated aspect dial**: 1 band = 1.00, 2 = 2.02, 4 = 4.04.
**⚠ UNVERIFIED: does `0 up / 0 down` actually apply?** #174 was launched to be that control and produced 190×768 anyway. **Pre-flight: the strip must read 1 level / 36,100 cells.** If it does and still yields 768, that is a chooser regression — this widget has silently failed before.

### ⚠ THE CHOOSER UI — own the widget, don't patch the data
**`Dialog_AdvancedGameConfig.MapSizes` is `static readonly` and the reflection swap SILENTLY FAILED in play.** The postfix also re-snapped `GameInitData.mapSize` **every frame**. **Now:** our own radio buttons write `mapSize` directly. Window grown via an `InitialSize` postfix — **vanilla lays its columns from the top and never consults the height.**

# 3. CROSS-BAND MOVEMENT
Segmented at ONE interception: `StartPath` prefix → tick sweep → `Carry` re-issues `StartPath`. `ABWormhole.TryGetTransit` **BFSes the band graph**; hops must strictly decrease or pawns ping-pong.
**Caveat:** an intermediate level must be walkable between arrival and the next staircase. **STILL UNTESTED IN PLAY.**

# 4. GROUP ORDERING
**Correct:** `RecomputeDestinations` spreads the selection along the drag line, which between bands runs through the GUTTER. Odd/even signature ("3 and 5 fail, 2 and 4 don't") is the proof: only ODD counts sample exactly 0.5. Fix = normalise `start`/`end` into the commanded pawns' band. **Verified.**

# 5. ⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE — `ABBands.TryResolveVisibleBelow`
Descends while each level is see-through, stops at the first opaque floor or the bottom band. **NINE systems share it. SEVEN appearances of the single-`- Slot` bug. VERIFIED FIXED (#168).**
**Sun-shadow subtlety:** its mask is *neighbour*-based, so mask and descent are answered together by `TryResolveDropAround`, taking the **smallest** drop among the nine cells.
**Still single-band:** the realtime-things pass in `ABBelowDynamicDraw` (motes, fire).

# 6. SKY-MASS PRESENTATION — verified in play
**⚠ FOUR REJECTED ATTEMPTS:** force-linked wall masks · high-queue cover · wall-sprite suppression · theorising twice about "flat" mountains before running the below-layer report.
Despeckle (**wall dissolves only at 7+ open neighbours**) · one central fog hole · five-terrain plateau palette · cliff faces · alpine pass (shallow-only tarns, per-cell 6-cell edge rule, rim scree, exposure-thinned flora).
**Ore glyph bug:** ore defs have no `naturalTerrain` ⇒ a "can't happen" fallback drew the whole **atlas sheet** per cell.

# 6b. ⚠ WATER — **1.6 water is a TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE effect**
`SectionLayer_Watergen` (vanilla, **`internal`**) is `SectionLayer_Terrain` + `waterDepthMaterial`, drawn to the **WaterDepth SUBCAMERA's** layer; the visible `Map/TerrainWater` samples that (`_WaterOutputTex`) **at its own screen position**.
- **Water vanished from upper levels — FIXED (#171).** `SectionLayer_ABBelowWatergen` mirrors the internal Watergen and **overrides `DrawLayer` to target `SubcameraDefOf.WaterDepth.LayerId`**.
- **Rivers — FIXED (#167, #172).** Remap `GetRiverCenter` (not `Init`) preserving the *roll*; **`GetLakeCenter` needs the same patch or it undoes the first**.
- **The flow path is BAND-CORRECT and PROVEN IRRELEVANT** to the streaking.

# 6b-LAKE. **CLOSED (#173/#174) — surface streaking accepted as vanilla appearance.**
**PROVEN:** a tile with water but no water mutators (`riverGraph 0 · riverFlowMap NULL · riverFlowTexture null · water=580 · baseRiver=0`) **still streaked**. No flow data exists ⇒ flow cannot be the cause. **Ghost-river theory dead.**
**NOT proven:** residual appearance never root-caused; leading hypothesis was `_MapSize` aspect anisotropy (4.04) and the ratio controls were never run. **User decision: fine, stop.**
En route: vanilla's flow builder ends `zero /= (float)num3` **unguarded** ⇒ NaN into a bilinear texture.

# 6c. DUBS MINT MINIMAP — **VERIFIED (#169).** Reflection-only, **no foreign type in any signature**; detection by **type presence**. **ONE RECT, NOT SEVEN PATCHES.** `DrawTextureFitted` preserves the TEXTURE's aspect — use `ScaleMode.StretchToFill`.

# 6d. MAP PREVIEW — **VERIFIED (#171).** Generate at full stacked height, show only the band's rows. `MaxMapSize`/`MapSizeOverride` are public static fields; `MaxMapSize.z` MUST rise. Three patches: `DetermineMapSize` postfix (the CLAMPED entry point), `MapPreviewResult.get_TexCoords` to crop, `OnWorldTileSelected` for window width.

# 6e. ⚠ COASTLINES — **VERIFIED (#171).** `36100 of 36100 water` — the precision was the diagnosis. **CENTRED wrong, not scaled wrong.** `z' = (z % Slot) + (map.Size.z - bandHeight) / 2`. **NO SCALING.** Nine coastal mutators, **none override `GetNoiseValue`**.

# 7. PER-LEVEL CHARACTER — **REWRITTEN. The old justification here was FALSE.**
Ore `×(1+0.45×(depth-1))`, cave openness `×(1+0.35×(depth-1))`, both AFTER the settings clamp. Basement temp flat **-6**.

### ⚠ THE SNOW LINE NEVER WORKED, AND THE COMMENT EXPLAINING WHY IT DIDN'T NEED TO WAS WRONG
Generation-time snow seeding was deleted on the stated grounds that *"vanilla melts and accumulates snow using each CELL's own temperature, so a cold high level keeps its snow"*. **That is not true.** `SteadyEnvironmentEffects.SteadyEnvironmentEffectsTick` computes
`outdoorMeltAmount = MeltAmountAt(map.mapTemperature.OutdoorTemp)` **once per tick for the entire map** and applies it to every outdoor cell. It never calls `GenTemperature.TryGetTemperatureForCell` — the only thing the per-level offset patches. So +3 melted at exactly the surface's rate, always had, and deleting the seeding removed the only thing putting snow up there at all.
**This is the map-wide-scalar shape of the slicing rule (§1).** The value is correct; it is just not per-band.

### The lapse table — ACCELERATING, no ceiling
| Level | Offset | Intent |
|---|---|---|
| +1 | **−7** | cool upland, seasons unchanged |
| +2 | **−16** | **THE SEASONAL SNOW LINE** — white in winter, bare in high summer |
| +3 | **−35** | permanent cap in any ordinary biome |
Chosen so a temperate summer (~30) lands +3 at −5, while a **desert (~45) or a heat wave DOES thaw it** — melting the cap is meant to be possible, just extreme. **Deliberately NO ceiling clamp**, because a clamp would make an extreme biome unable to overcome it. Levels past the table extrapolate at the last step.
**⚠ BALANCE CONSEQUENCE, ACCEPTED BY DESIGN:** −35 makes +3 genuinely hostile — serious cold gear, nothing grows — and **an existing save with a base at +2 will get much colder** (−16 vs the old −8).
Snow is now confined to real ground: `AB_OpenAir` and `AB_WallTop` set **`holdSnowOrSand=false`** (§16).

# 8. CAMERA
`freeCameraPan` REMOVED. `ABCameraBounds.For(level)` keyed by **level**; **`maxZoom` DERIVED**; **`panMargin` 63.5 on EVERY level (§15c) — VERIFIED (#172).** Calibration dialog opens with the clamp UNLOCKED.

# 9. ⚠ GENERATION COST — top open item
| Config | Tile | Carve | Destroyed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 × 190 (#168) | sparse | 2.5 s | 15,787 |
| 4 × 190 (#171) | coast | 15.2 s | 50,585 |
| 4 × 190 (#172) | lake+river+shrines | 3.1 s | 20,095 |
| 4 × 190 (#173) | bog, no mutators | **2.3 s** | 15,031 |
| 4 × 190 (#174) | **mountainous** | **17.1 s** | **78,520** |
| 7 × 126 | — | 30.4 s | 62,686 |
**⚠ BIOME CONTENT, NOT CELL COUNT** — 7.4× between #173 and #174 at identical size. **Any carve timing MUST record the tile.**
**⚠ FALSIFIED AT #174: "band 1's sky clear is ~3× bands 2-3."** Measured band 1 = 3.6 s, **band 2 = 8.5 s**, band 3 = 4.8 s. **Do NOT scope the doomed-band skip to band 1.**
**`Sky clear` ~97% of the carve**; **`0 rocks spawned`**. **THE FIX — extend the doomed-band genstep skip** (precedent: 16.9 s → 4.2 s). Targets: `RocksFromGrid`, `Terrain`, `RockChunks`, `Plants`, `ScatterRuinsSimple`, `CaveHives`, `MutatorPostElevationFertility`.
**HARD CONSTRAINT: per-cell gensteps scope safely; `map.Area`-count scatterers do NOT** (the scatterer family counts off `Size.x²`, so it is safe). **Do not blanket-skip the water/coast mutators.**

# 10. RUNTIME PERF — 59.6 fps @96 pawns, mod ≈2% frame.
# 11. VERTICAL LINKS — elevator SHIPPED, **untested**.

# 12. DIAGNOSTICS
band info · below layer/pawn reports · **water report** · transit health · stuck probe · lighting/shader/biome reports · bisect toggles · ABGenProfile · camera calibration.
**⚠ Bisect toggles PERSIST across runs** — #172 opened with `belowWater=False` from an earlier session, which mimics a fixed bug exactly. **Read the bisect line before trusting any water observation.**

# 13. OPEN WORK
1. **Play-test the altitude pass (§7/§16)** — needs a colony with +2/+3 and a rainstorm.
2. **Doomed-band genstep scoping pass** (§9). Re-measure per band per tile; the band-1 heuristic is dead.
3. **Verify `0 up / 0 down` reaches generation** (§2).
4. **Audit the other `FalloffAtAngle` mutators.**
5. **Never exercised:** multi-hop stair router, elevator, reload fix. **Basement paths untested** — #172-#174 were all 3-up/0-down.
6. Realtime-things pass single-band · selection bracket drifts on zoom-out · waterfalls · COMBAT never verified · compat audit · **store page still says three levels**.

# 14. LESSONS (telegraphic)
**PROVE A SUBSYSTEM INNOCENT BY FINDING A STATE WHERE THE SUSPECT CANNOT EXIST** — #173's zero-flow map killed the flow theory in one screenshot · **a documented rejection may be re-opened ONLY by naming the confound** · **change ONE thing per experiment** · **not every bug has a bug** — §6b-LAKE ended as vanilla appearance · **⚠ A COMMENT ASSERTING WHY SOMETHING IS SAFE TO DELETE IS A CLAIM, NOT A FACT — VERIFY IT** (§7's snow line was dead for months behind a confident, wrong sentence) · **RE-MEASURE THE ASSUMPTION YOU ARE ABOUT TO BUILD ON** (band-1 carve heuristic died on the fifth run) · **look for MAP-WIDE SCALARS: a per-tick value computed once for the whole map is invisible to per-cell patches** · **when a shared per-tick field is rewritten per cell, rewrite it on EVERY cell including the default case** — leaving it alone leaks the previous cell's value in random order · **patch the idempotent READ, not the cached WRITE** — scaling `DesiredPowerOutput` is safe, scaling a field refreshed every 250 ticks compounds · **check whether vanilla reads the CACHED field or the LIVE property** — snowfall gates on the field and amounts from the property · **an EXACT number is a diagnosis** · **use the product's own knobs as lab equipment** · **a beautiful fit is not evidence** · **the ABSENCE of a known error line is a valid pass signal** · **a UNIFORM symptom is a scale/constant, a PATCHY one is data** · **A STACKED MAP IS 2-7× ANISOTROPIC** · **defaults matter: `TerrainDef.holdSnowOrSand` defaults TRUE, so custom "void" terrain collects snow unless told not to** · **two runs of the same config are only comparable if the TILE matches** · **when N call sites share ONE linear mapping, re-aim the shared parameter** · **find the ONE virtual everything funnels through** · **read the foreign mod's OWN compat classes first** · **never put a foreign type in a patch-class signature** · **re-centre, don't rescale** · **position-based noise means a SLICE of a tall map ≠ a short map** · **an odd/even symptom is arithmetic** · **grep every `- Slot`** · **patch the method that PRODUCES a value, not the one that stores it** · **own the widget instead of patching the data it reads** · **ALTITUDE IS DRAW ORDER** (`WorldClipper` > `Skyfaller`) · **`Banded` is FALSE for the whole of map generation** · **a null global texture falls back to the SHADER'S default, not zero** · **vanilla divides by a count without guarding zero** · ore defs have no naturalTerrain · a `Graphic_Linked` base material is the whole ATLAS SHEET · **"can't happen" fallbacks are what the player photographs** · enforce spatial rules PER CELL · **balance GUI clip/group pops in a `finally`** · statics keyed by game-scoped ids leak — CWT · **Unity textures are not GC'd with their owner** · **any type with a `Material` field needs `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]`** · never cache comps while Scribe active · FinalizeInit = worker thread · `SectionLayer` subclasses are **auto-discovered**.

---

# 15. QOL PASS — **ALL VERIFIED IN PLAY (#172)**
**15a. Nothing may exist in the void** — `ABBandSafety.cs`. Three redundant layers: the **finders** (`RandomEdgeCell(Rot4,Map)`, 5-arg `TryFindRandomEdgeCellWith`, `RandomCell`) answer inside the SURFACE band; a prefix on the **7-arg `GenSpawn.Spawn`** (every overload funnels into it) rewrites `loc` before vanilla reads it; a **120-tick sweep** (`Position` + `Notify_Teleported`) catches teleports and pre-fix saves. **Always relocates to the surface** — a spawn that landed in the void has proven its chooser does not understand bands. Scoped to Pawns and the GUTTER only.
**15b. Structures must not straddle a seam** — `GenGrid.CloseToEdge` measured against `map.Size`, so the surface band reported itself as inland everywhere including the seam rows, silently voiding every generator's edge declaration. One prefix re-bases onto the cell's own band rect; eleven cold call sites inherit it. Backstop: `GenStep_Scatterer.CanScatterAt` postfix rejects within 10 of a Z seam (base reaches the family — every override opens with `if (!base.CanScatterAt(...))`).
**15c. Camera bounds** — `panMargin` 63.5 now on every level. There was never a per-level reason; the view clip guarantees overhang shows curtain.
**15d. No-build map edge REMOVED on banded maps** — `ABNoBuildEdge.cs`. Both halves were stack-anchored. **Per-band is one flag away** (`Removed`). **Consequence:** vanilla's strip is also what stops a colony sealing its map edge.
**15e. Drop pods fall through the levels** — `ABSkyfallerRelay.cs`. The curtain (`WorldClipper`) sorts **above** `Skyfaller` so most of every descent was painted over; and pods bound elsewhere were view-culled. Suppress `Skyfaller.DrawAt`, re-issue once via `DrawNowAt` translated by `(viewedBand - itsBand) * Slot`. **Altitude chosen per frame** — lifting unconditionally renders landings at full brightness through the night lighting overlay. `Skyfaller_FlyingPawn` excluded (it overrides `DrawAt`).

# 16. ALTITUDE / WEATHER PASS — `ABBandWeather.cs`. **BUILD GREEN, UNTESTED**
**THE CONSTRAINT:** `WeatherManager` is per-Map and there is ONE Map — one `curWeather`, one Rain/SnowRate, one wind, for all seven levels. Weather is therefore **not simulated per band; it is one weather INTERPRETED per band.**

**Snow confined to real ground.** `AB_OpenAir` + `AB_WallTop` → `holdSnowOrSand=false`. `TerrainDef.holdSnowOrSand` **defaults to true** and `SnowGrid.CanHaveSnow` consults nothing else, so open air was collecting snow — on a sky band that is the whole screen white, and the gutter did it too. Wall tops match vanilla walls, which hold no snow (`CanCoexistWithSnow` rejects Full fillage). Old saves self-clear: `AddDepth` zeroes non-holding cells on the next call.

**Melt, per band.** Prefix on `SteadyEnvironmentEffects.DoCellSteadyEffects` rewrites the private `outdoorMeltAmount` from the cell's own band temperature. **Written on EVERY call including level 0** — the field is shared across ~87 cells per tick, so skipping the surface would hand it whatever the last sky cell installed, at random, depending on `cellsInRandomOrder`. `MeltAmountAt` returns **0 below freezing**, so a sub-zero band never loses snow with no bespoke "permanent" flag.

**Tier 2 — rain falls as snow above the freezing line.** Postfix on the same method calls the public `AddFallenSnowAt(c, 0.046f * RainRate)` for sub-zero sky bands. **Field rewriting does NOT work here:** vanilla gates on the cached `snowRate` field but takes the amount from the LIVE `map.weatherManager.SnowRate`, so forcing the field passes the gate and adds exactly zero. Matches vanilla's own roof/room gates or snow appears indoors. One storm = rain below, blizzard on the peak.

**Tier 1 — no weather overlays underground.** Prefix on `WeatherManager.DrawAllWeather`, which is purely visual (event draw + the two workers' full-screen overlays) — no simulation, sound or accumulation touched, and the basement's roof already blocks real precipitation. Judged on the **viewed band**, since overlays are screen-space and have no per-cell answer. Sky bands keep their weather.

**Wind scales with altitude** — `×1.15 / ×1.30 / ×1.50` at +1/+2/+3, **0 underground**. Patched on the `DesiredPowerOutput` **getter**, not `CompTick`: the turbine only recomputes `cachedPowerOutput` every 250 ticks, so a CompTick postfix would re-multiply the stored field on the 249 ticks between and run away exponentially. `UpdateDesiredPowerOutput` reads the getter fresh each tick, so scaling there is idempotent by construction. Applied **after** vanilla's `Min(WindSpeed, 1.5f)` cap deliberately — the cap limits the weather, altitude is a separate multiplier on top, so a ridge turbine can exceed the sea-level ceiling. That is the payback for the cold. Inspect string explains the bonus (an unexplained multiplier reads as a bug).

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true`. **Compat tests need the target mod as a companion** — Dubs (`dubwise.dubsmintminimap`) and Map Preview (`m00nl1ght.MapPreview`) are INACTIVE in the user's real list. Multi-level tests need `quicktest=false`. **Note the tile in any perf comparison.** **A `surfaceBand=0` config cannot exercise band-folded addressing.**
**Altitude pass needs:** levels +2 AND +3, and a **rain** weather forced from the debug palette to see rain-below/snow-above. Check the wind-turbine inspect line at two different levels. **Check the bisect line before trusting any water/snow observation.**
